mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium) and volume depletion may increase abacavir exposure variability and reduce renal clearance, while abacavir has no direct effect on torsemide metabolism.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes and renal function regularly; maintain adequate hydration and consider potassium supplementation if needed; ensure stable abacavir levels through consistent adherence.
